subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview-tour first-run experience be adopted on top of current main, narrowed to sample-preview pieces, or paused in favor of the newer merged onboarding direction?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only mechanical because current main has since landed overlapping onboarding, routing, security-copy, and typography decisions after this branch.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-Gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview-only follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample preview behavior maintainers still want and leave setup/security-copy work to focused current-main PRs.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat the merged onboarding refresh and narrower follow-ups as the maintained direction if the preview tour is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-Gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent ownership signal for the configured-Gateway routing behavior this PR must preserve.
